items.source: Create a ContextCustomizer that should be used to customize a ConfigurableApplicationContext before it is refreshed.
items.translation: 创建一个 `ContextCustomizer`，用于在刷新之前自定义一个`ConfigurableApplicationContext`。

items.source: Factories are invoked after ContextLoaders have processed context configuration attributes but before the MergedContextConfiguration is created.
items.translation: 工厂在 `ContextLoaders` 处理完上下文配置属性之后、但在创建 `MergedContextConfiguration` 之前被调用。

items.source: By default, the Spring TestContext Framework will use the SpringFactoriesLoader mechanism for loading default factories configured in all META-INF/spring.factories files on the classpath.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring TestContext Framework 将使用SpringFactoriesLoader机制来加载类路径上所有META-INF/spring.factories文件中配置的默认工厂。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, it is also possible to register factories declaratively via the @ContextCustomizerFactories annotation.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，也可以通过 `@ContextCustomizerFactories` 注解以声明方式注册工厂。

items.source: configAttributes - the list of context configuration attributes for the test class, ordered bottom-up (i.e., as if we were traversing up the class hierarchy or enclosing class hierarchy); never null or empty
items.translation: configAttributes - 测试类的上下文配置属性列表，按自底向上（即，如同遍历类层次结构或包含的类层次结构）的顺序排列；绝不可能是 `null` 或空

items.source: a ContextCustomizer or null if no customizer should be used
items.translation: 一个 `ContextCustomizer` 或 `null`，如果不应使用自定义器。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
